sources.capture_note: Captured 26 October 2026 (188,225 bytes). Reached from https://cloudhq.com/campuses/ (cloudhq-campuses.html, sha256 e59b17c6...), which lists 'KIX Campus | Japan | Osaka, Japan'. robots.txt of cloudhq.com and www.cloudhq.com (HTTP 200; only /wp-admin/ disallowed) recorded before the first request. sources.summary: CloudHQ's campus page names the KIX Campus and publishes the coordinate pair 34.63940, 135.42107 under the heading, with 1,345,489 sq ft / 125,000 m2, 96.4 MW available and total critical IT load, and 'RFS Planned for June 2025'. It describes CloudHQ's Cosmosquare, a 96 MW hyperscale data-centre campus in Nanko Kita, Osaka City, within 10 km of the Osaka CBD exchanges, to be developed over three phases (KIX1, KIX2 & KIX3). The KIX phase names are CloudHQ's; ESR names the same campus's phases OS1 to OS3. Capacity figures are the operator's campus-level planning figures (they differ from ESR's 130 MW / 120 MW IT statements) and are not attributed to OS2.
sources.date_semantics: Undated operator page; used for the campus locator and campus description only. The RFS line refers to the first phase and is a forecast; no status is taken from this page.
